device: Existing NVIDIA RTX 5090; second run explicitly selects Vulkan0

first_run.failure: Invented a 1-minute centrifugation duration not reported in the source; the quoted sentence contained speed but no duration.

limitations: One already reviewed page, not a held-out or full-paper validation.
Exact quote-span matching alone does not establish that a quote supports the proposed value.
No draft, model result or retest counts as a new published paper.
Independent source and sample/figure review remain mandatory.

numeric_grounding.definition: Every numeric claim the model emitted was checked against the relevant source page and was correct in context. This does not reward omitted expected values; omissions are reflected in target_coverage.

quote_span.definition: Mechanical exact contiguous span after NFKC Unicode normalization and whitespace collapse. Quotes that use ellipses, paraphrase, or expand the source do not pass.

quote_support.definition: Manual check whether the quoted text supports the claims actually stated in the answer; kept distinct from exact-span matching and target completeness.

latency.interpretation: Local process wall time for three selected page-excerpt questionsets, including model/process startup; not a whole-paper or corpus throughput estimate.

separate_page_benchmark.qualification: Three already reviewed sources, four selected pages; no paid processing, source upload, model tuning on these answers, new paper credit, or full-paper capacity inference. Numeric grounding is scored per answer and does not count omitted numbers as correct.
separate_page_benchmark.freeze_time_note: The serialized preregistration timestamp predates the file modification time; the exact content hash was checked by the runner before inference. No frozen inputs changed after inference.
